description: Judge a proposed meeting instant for each city. Use when the user already has a clock time, such as "Tuesday 9am PT with London and Tokyo — is that bad?". Pass start as an ISO instant, or as a floating local time with home set to an IANA timezone. Paste shareText. Time API computes the UTC instant, local lines, verdicts, and up to three better aiSlots. Do not invent wall-clock times. If context is set, tell the user that sentence. It says whether daylight saving skipped the local time or made it happen twice.

_endUserId.description: Optional opaque per-call end-user attribution token populated by the MCP host, not the LLM. Use a non-PII hash or token; never send raw email, name, or platform user ID.

anyOf.description: Optional ISO country hints aligned to locations.
Optional ISO country hints aligned to locations.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD when start is only a clock time.

durationMinutes.description: Optional. Only 30, 45, or 60 are written onto the planner link.

home.description: IANA timezone for a floating start, such as America/Los_Angeles.

anyOf.description: Two or more cities or timezones.
Two or more cities or timezones.

start.description: ISO instant with a UTC offset, or a floating local time such as 2026-09-29T09:00 or 9:00am.

workEnd.description: Last in-hours local hour, inclusive. Default 18.

name: check_proposed_time
